claims: Toluca eliminated the LA Galaxy from the 2026 CONCACAF Champions Cup quarterfinals on April 15, 2026.
Toluca secured a 4-2 aggregate victory over the LA Galaxy.
Toluca advanced to the semifinals of the 2026 CONCACAF Champions Cup.
The second leg was held on April 15, 2026.
The second leg was held at Dignity Health Sports Park in Carson, CA.
Toluca won the first leg 3-2 on April 8, 2026 in Mexico.
The matchup was a 2026 CONCACAF Champions Cup quarterfinal.
LA Galaxy is led by Greg Vanney.
LA Galaxy played this match in the middle of their MLS campaign.
Toluca came into the match leading in Liga MX.
The clubs had previously met in the 2025 Campeones Cup.
Toluca won 3-2 in the 2025 Campeones Cup.
Some fans described Toluca as the best team in Concacaf
